events.title: Rio de Janeiro is founded
events.description: Portuguese forces under Estácio de Sá founded the city of São Sebastião do Rio de Janeiro on the shores of Guanabara Bay.
events.significance: The settlement secured Portugal's hold on the Brazilian coast against French rivals. It grew into one of the world's best-known cities and, for a time, the capital of Brazil.

events.title: The Salem witch trials begin
events.description: In Salem Village, Massachusetts, the first arrests were made after local girls accused neighbors of witchcraft. Tituba, Sarah Good and Sarah Osborne were the first to be examined.
events.significance: The panic led to the executions of twenty people and the deaths of others in jail. It remains a lasting warning about mass hysteria and unfair trials.

events.title: Yellowstone becomes the first national park
events.description: President Ulysses S. Grant signed legislation setting aside Yellowstone's geysers, canyons and wildlife as a public park.
events.significance: It is widely regarded as the world's first national park. It started a global conservation movement that now protects landscapes in countries around the world.

events.title: The first organized indoor ice hockey game is played
events.description: At the Victoria Skating Rink in Montreal, James Creighton and a group of McGill University students played the first recorded indoor game of ice hockey.
events.significance: The game helped set early rules and traditions for hockey. It is often seen as a key step in the sport's growth into a major professional game.

events.title: Korea's March 1st Movement begins
events.description: Koreans across the country took to the streets to peacefully demand independence from Japanese colonial rule, after a declaration of independence was read in Seoul.
events.significance: Though it was suppressed, the movement became a defining symbol of Korean national identity. It helped inspire the creation of a provisional government in exile, and South Korea still marks March 1 as a national holiday.
